meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在 NanoClaw 里新增一个 Emacs 通道：在 Emacs 中开聊天缓冲区可直接提问，也能发送选中的 org 内容；回复会作为子标题写回 org，并自动转成 org-mode 格式。全程走本机 HTTP，不需要 bot token 或外部服务。
howto.when: 当你说“把 Emacs 加成一个通道”、或要求从 Emacs 里接入 NanoClaw 时，Claude 会开始配置；配置完后，在 Emacs 打开聊天缓冲区或发送 org 内容即触发对话。

say.text: 把 Emacs 加为 NanoClaw 的一个通道。
我用 Doom Emacs，想在编辑器里直接问 NanoClaw。
say.note: 会按 Doom 的配置方式接入 Emacs 通道。

say.text: 帮我在 vanilla Emacs 里给聊天和 org 发送配上快捷键。
say.note: 会添加聊天与 org 发送对应的按键。

howto.what_en: Adds an Emacs channel to NanoClaw: chat from an Emacs buffer or send org content, and replies come back as child headings. Markdown is auto-converted to org-mode. Runs over local HTTP — no bot token or external service.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks to add Emacs as a channel or to connect to NanoClaw from Emacs; Claude then runs the setup. After setup, opening the chat buffer or sending org content starts the conversation.

say_en.text: Add Emacs as a channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the install and enable flow.

say_en.text: I use Doom Emacs and want to ask NanoClaw from the editor.
say_en.note: Configures the Emacs channel the Doom way.

say_en.text: In vanilla Emacs, bind keys for chat and org sending.
say_en.note: Adds the chat and org-send keybindings.
